physical_test: Build and install alpha.21 on the owner Mac.
Ask the same English memory questions used in the previous packaged regression.
Keep every durable per-question private audit log.
Confirm that message selection and per-message extraction are visible as separate stages.
Score the human answer before enabling any shared-server option for another owner.
release_boundary: Do not send this build to another owner until the owner Mac receives a grounded answer and an unanswerable control stops safely.
privacy: The builder contains no owner memory or credentials. Selected evidence still travels to the owner-controlled yukabox in this development configuration.
